description: The bar chart illustrates the ratio of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, for three different models: Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the Ratio (%) with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, marked at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of three bars corresponding to the three models, colored blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT. For Movies, Llama3 and Qwen2 have ratios around 90%, while ChatGPT has a ratio of approximately 73%. In the Songs category, Llama3 has a ratio of about 83%, Qwen2 is around 90%, and ChatGPT is roughly 61%. For Basketball, Llama3 has a ratio of approximately 68%, Qwen2 is around 57%, and ChatGPT is about 61%. The bars within each category are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized.
